communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All records held by EPA created in preparation for, distributed or received during and/or as the result of the "Phone call with Senator Alan Armstrong" on May 14, 2026 in Washington, D.C. as listed on EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin's public calendar. 

Please click on this link for more detail on Zeldin's calendar, which lists this meeting (https://www.epa.gov/senior-leaders-calendars/calendar-lee-zeldin-epa-administrator). Please consider any calendar entries, emails, invitations electronic or otherwise, handwritten notes, letters, memorandums, text messages, voice and video recordings as well as other documented forms of communication as responsive records to my request. Please also consider any follow-up emails or other communications as a result of this call as responsive records to my request. Please also consider any final briefing materials created for this meeting that were either created by EPA or provided to EPA participants in this meeting and/or as the result of this meeting as responsive records to my request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Molly Taft
